overall: MARGINAL: calm north and east, windy south and Ciron
limiterDetail: Main limiter: wind. Wind is ENE–E and sustained per ECMWF. On the south grounds it is 16–18 kt until ~9 AM, eases to ~12 kt around noon–2 PM, then rebuilds to ~15 kt from ~6 PM and stays at 14–16 kt overnight. Ciron is 14–19.6 kt all 24h. Coron, Culion, Galoc, Tara, Turda and Decabobo are 5.7–8 kt now, rise to 11–12.7 kt from ~10 AM to 2 PM, and ease again tonight. Rain is mostly light, with a heavier burst ~6–9 PM in the south and west. Currents are mild (0.2–0.6 kt now).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR of gale, tropical cyclone wind signal and heavy-rain alerts for Calamian / MIMAROPA. New since yesterday: General Flood Advisory #2, Region 4-B (MIMAROPA) , Fri 5:37 AM PHT (update to #1 from Thu 5:35 PM). It says the ITCZ is affecting Palawan, with light to moderate rain and thunderstorms over the next 12 hours, and lists rivers in Busuanga and Coron. That fits ECMWF's light-to-moderate rain; watch for thunderstorm squalls.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Sunday's recovery is back: Sun 18 is GOOD again (was MARGINAL). Rain dropped to ~6.5 mm (was ~11.8) and wind is light (6.5 kt, gusts 13). That makes Sun 18, Mon 19 and Tue 20 all GOOD, and Thu 22 is now the best day of the week (3.3 kt, gusts 10, ~2.5 mm). The refill of stock moves back up to Sunday evening (was Monday evening), and the thin stretch shrinks to Fri–Sat. The shortage alert eased from ELEVATED to MILD.

This morning the south grounds are rough again. Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot are POOR on wind (15.7–16.4 kt, gusts ~22, peaking ~18 kt around 8 AM). Ciron is at 14.8 kt and will hit ~19.6 kt by 8 AM. North and east are calm: 6 grounds are GOOD (was 3).

Also: Sat 17 is now the week's worst day (13 kt, gusts 20, ~9.1 mm). GFS now agrees with ECMWF on wind (4.1 vs 6.3 kt; it disagreed yesterday). PAGASA put out a General Flood Advisory for Palawan at 5:37 AM: light to moderate rain and thunderstorms over the next 12 hours, with Busuanga and Coron rivers listed. It is a flood advisory, not a gale warning.

bestWindow.headline: Now–~9 AM (Coron, Culion, Galoc, Decabobo, Turda) · ~9 PM–Sat 5 AM (Decabobo, Turda)
details: Now–~9 AM: Coron, Culion and Galoc have 5.8–8 kt wind, currents 0.1–0.4 kt and no rain (Coron near slack). Decabobo and Turda have 5.7–7.3 kt and are dry, with Decabobo at 0.2 kt (Turda 0.3–0.5). Head in before ~10 AM, when wind climbs to 11–12.7 kt.

~9 PM–Sat 5 AM: Decabobo has 3.3–6 kt wind, current 0.1–0.4 kt and only light rain (0.2 mm/h). The model's single best hour is Sat ~5 AM at Decabobo (3.6 kt, current 0.1 kt). Turda has the same light wind, but its current runs 0.7–1.0 kt until ~midnight, so go after ~1 AM (0.3–0.5 kt). Tara is similar but its current holds 0.8–1.1 kt until ~1 AM. The model rates the next 24h POOR overall because of the south and Ciron.
Keep boats off Ciron all day (14–19.6 kt), and off Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot this morning (17–18 kt ~7–9 AM) and tonight (14–16 kt, plus showers ~6–9 PM). Alava gets 15.7–17 kt ~7–9 PM.

currentsSourceLine: Source: Open-Meteo Marine currents (includes tides). Not ECMWF. Fetched Fri 16 Oct 6:18 AM PHT. “Now” = 6 AM; range = next 24h (to Sat 5 AM).
